run_evaluate_kilt_predictions: run the evaluate function to compute downstream and KILT metrics comparing gold and guess KILT files
run_normalize_answer: run the normalize_answer function to lowercase text and remove punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace
run_f1_score: run the _f1_score function to compute token-level F1 between a prediction and ground truth answer
run_exact_match_score: run the _exact_match_score function to check if a normalized prediction exactly matches a ground truth answer
run_rougel_score: run the _rougel_score function to compute the ROUGE-L F1 score between a prediction and ground truth
